WHAT OKLAHOMA IS BUYING (research, Sep 2026)
1. Used motor vehicle dealer bond: $25,000 (rebuilders $15,000). Your #1 bond line already.
2. CIB contractor license bond: $5,000 continuous, all CIB trades incl. roofing (HB 1628 roofing endorsement drives new registrations). Board also requires $50K GL: cross sell.
3. Notary bond: raised to $10,000 on Jan 1, 2026 (was $1,000). Every renewal needs the new amount.
4. Lost title bonds: steady walk in demand from Service Oklahoma.
5. Court bonds: probate, guardianship, appeal. Attorney referral play.
Markets: RLI (40% commission), Bond Exchange, Ashton, Travelers.

PURCHASE LINK: no bond specific form exists yet. All buttons point to okcinsurancebrokers.com/bond-insurance/ plus (405) 509-9433.
Recommended: add a free Jotform "Surety Bond Application" (3 of 5 slots used) and swap the button URL before posting.
Row 1 and 2: the five ads (1200x628 for Facebook and LinkedIn link posts). Row 3: two alternate looks for the same dealer ad.
